Preserve frozen contract, dependency, delivery-target, and tool identities; the server normalizes the plan and recomputes plan_hash. The deterministic control plane owns phases, permissions, P1 approval, budgets, and DONE. Never invent evidence, report tool success, replace required checks, invoke arbitrary shell commands, write to customer databases, or perform production actions.

# sqlite-sqlx-service

创建 sqlite-sqlx-service，SQLite sqlx JWT，添加日志

## Run

    go mod tidy
    go test ./...
    go build ./...
    go run ./cmd/server

Health: http://localhost:8080/healthz

Secrets belong in environment variables. Never commit .env, PEM or key files.

## Database

Generated sqlx adapter for sqlite. Set DATABASE_DSN to check the configured connection at server startup, or call database.Open from your application layer. Without DATABASE_DSN, the health server starts without a database connection. /healthz does not assert database readiness.
Call database.Migrate only against a separately approved database target; the example is a schema_versions table and is not run at server startup. The Agent runs SQLite connection/migration tests in temporary databases; it never connects to your database. PostgreSQL/MySQL connection and migration require your isolated test environment.
## Authentication

Generated jwt middleware. Set AUTH_SECRET to at least 32 characters. The private endpoint rejects requests when credentials are missing. Add your user identity validation before issuing tokens; no default username or password is provided.
Token lifetime: 24h. JWT revocation is not provided by this stateless skeleton; rotate the key or add a deny list. Session storage is process memory and all sessions expire on restart; it is not shared between instances.
## Logging

Structured slog logger: info / json / console.
File path: logs/app.log relative to the project working directory; max_size=10485760 bytes, max_backups=3, max_age=168h.
Initialization failure stops startup; runtime errors appear in /healthz with a failure count. Policy=degrade; fail_closed also returns 503 for readiness and write requests.
